xhtml:iframe.title: Cine Cloud OS
xhtml:iframe.srcdoc:
<! --

WELCOME TO CINE CLOUD,

As i promised code is 100% opensourced, feel free to fork it, copy it, remake it whatever.

I should have put like helpful comments for ya here and there that can help you.

 --!>



<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Cine-Cloud OS</title>
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&family=Great+Vibes&display=swap');

/* START OF CSS!!! */
:root {
  --bg: #050505;
  --glass: rgba(22, 22, 25, 0.6);
  --glass-hover: rgba(35, 35, 40, 0.8);
  --border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  --text: #f5f5f7;
  --muted: #888890; 
  --accent: #ffffff;
}











  /*BODY */
body {
  margin: 0; padding: 0; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text);
  font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; overflow-x: hidden;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; user-select: none;
  height: 100vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 0; }

/* BRANDING NOTCH */
.top-notch {
  background: var(--glass); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-top: none;
  border-bottom-left-radius: 18px; border-bottom-right-radius: 18px;
  padding: 8px 24px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
}
.top-notch img { width: 18px; opacity: 0.9; }
.top-notch span { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase;}

/* --- BOOTS --- */
#new-boot {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; background: #000; z-index: 9999999;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center;
  transition: opacity 0.6s ease;
}

.fig-title {
  font-size: 44px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 20px; margin-left: 20px; opacity: 0;
  animation: txtIn 1.5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) forwards;
}

.fig-line {
  width: 0; height: 2px; background: #fff; margin-top: 15px; opacity: 0;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px #fff; animation: lineGrow 1.5s ease 0.5s forwards;
}

@keyframes txtIn {
  0% { letter-spacing: 0px; opacity: 0; filter: blur(10px); transform:scale(0.9);}
  100% { letter-spacing: 20px; opacity: 1; filter: blur(0px); transform:scale(1);}
}

@keyframes lineGrow {
  0% { width: 0; opacity: 0; }
  10% { opacity: 1; }
  100% { width: 180px; opacity: 1; }
}


  /*FADE IN! */
@keyframes fadeIn {
  to { opacity: 1; }
}

/* --- Background(s?!?!? maybe ikd) --- */
#bg-amb {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; object-fit: cover; opacity: 0.06; 
  filter: blur(80px) saturate(120%); z-index: -1; 
  transition: opacity 1.5s ease, filter 1.5s ease; width: 100vw; height: 100vh;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* APPS */
#app-wrap {
  flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 60px 50px 180px 50px; scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

#cine-content, .grid-v, .tut-cnt, .settings-box {
  max-width: 1400px; margin: 0 auto; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box;
}

.tab-view { display: none; animation: slideUp 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards; }
.tab-view.active { display: block; }
@keyframes slideUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(25px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

.sec-head {
  font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.5px; margin-bottom: 25px; margin-top: 60px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: #fff; max-width: 1400px; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;
}
.sec-head::before { content: ''; width: 4px; height: 18px; background: #fff; border-radius: 4px; }

/* SEARCH INPUT */
.lib-search-wrap { margin-bottom: 30px; position: relative; max-width: 1400px; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;}
.lib-search-wrap input {
  width: 100%; padding: 18px 24px 18px 50px; border-radius: 16px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: #fff; font-size: 15px; outline: none; transition: 0.3s;
  font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; backdrop-filter: blur(10px); box-sizing: border-box;
}
.lib-search-wrap input:focus { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); }
.lib-search-wrap svg { position: absolute; left: 18px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 20px; height: 20px; stroke: #aaa; }

/* RECOMMENDES */
.marquee-wrap { width: 100%; overflow: hidden; position: relative; padding: 10px 0; border-radius: 16px; max-width: 1400px; margin: 0 auto;}
.marquee-track { display: flex; gap: 25px; width: max-content; animation: slideLeft 40s linear infinite; }
.marquee-track:hover { animation-play-state: paused; }
@keyframes slideLeft { 0% { transform: translateX(0); } 100% { transform: translateX(-50%); } }

/* --- Banner!! --- */
.hero-cont {
  width: 100%; height: 500px; border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden; position: relative;
  cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--border);
  transition: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
  box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); max-width: 1400px; margin: 0 auto;
}


  /*Hobver Animation*/
.hero-cont:hover {
  transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
}

.h-img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: opacity 0.5s ease, transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); opacity: 0.8;}
.hero-cont:hover .h-img { transform: scale(1.03); opacity: 1;}

.h-over {
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.95) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 60%, transparent 100%);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; padding: 60px;
}

.h-tag {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); color: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  padding: 8px 18px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 100px; letter-spacing: 1px;
  margin-bottom: 20px; align-self: flex-start; text-transform: uppercase;
}

.h-title { font-size: 60px; font-weight: 800; margin: 0 0 10px 0; letter-spacing: -2px; }
.h-stat { font-size: 15px; color: #aaa; display: flex; gap: 20px; font-weight: 500;}

/* This is the GRID! */
.grid-h { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(320px, 1fr)); gap: 25px; max-width: 1400px; margin: 0 auto; }
.grid-v { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 25px; }

.c-h {
  position: relative; aspect-ratio: 16/9; border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer;
  background: #080808; border: 1px solid var(--border); flex-shrink: 0;
  transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); width: 320px; /* fixed width for marquee */
}
.grid-h .c-h { width: 100%; } /* normal grids */

.c-v {
  position: relative; aspect-ratio: 3/4; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer;
  background: #080808; border: 1px solid var(--border);
  transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
}

.c-h img, .c-v img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; opacity: 0.7; transition: 0.5s; filter: grayscale(20%);}
.c-h:hover, .c-v:hover { transform: translateY(-8px); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); }
.c-h:hover img, .c-v:hover img { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.05); filter: grayscale(0%);}

.c-inf {
  position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; padding: 50px 25px 25px; box-sizing: border-box;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.95), transparent);
  opacity: 0; transform: translateY(15px); transition: 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
}
.c-h:hover .c-inf, .c-v:hover .c-inf { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
.c-inf h3 { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 6px 0; letter-spacing: -0.5px;}
.c-inf span { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; font-weight: 500;}

.c-time-hover {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 11px; color: #aaa;
  margin-top: 8px; font-weight: 600;
}
.c-time-hover svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; stroke: #aaa; }

/* THE Bottom Dock */
.dock-wrap {
  position: fixed; bottom: 35px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 15px; z-index: 10000000000;
}

.main-dock {
  background: var(--glass); backdrop-filter: blur(15px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(15px);
  
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 80px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 10px 14px;
  box-shadow: 0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
  
}

.d-logo {
  width: 26px; height: 26px; margin: 0 12px 0 10px; object-fit: contain;
  opacity: 0.8; transition: 0.3s; cursor: pointer;
}

  
.d-logo:hover { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.1); }
.d-sep { width: 1px; height: 24px; background: var(--border); margin: 0 6px; }




  
.d-btn {
  padding: 10px 26px; border-radius: 100px; color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.3s;
}
.d-btn:hover { 
  color: #fff; 
  background: 
    rgba(255,255,255,0.05); 
}

  
.d-btn.active { 
  color: #000; 
  background: #fff; 
  font-weight: 600; 
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); 
}

.trk-widg {
  background: var(--glass); backdrop-filter: blur(30px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(30px);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 100px;
  height: 60px; padding: 6px; display: none; align-items: center; gap: 14px;
  box-sizing: border-box; overflow: hidden; max-width: 60px; 
  transition: max-width 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), background 0.3s;
  cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; box-shadow: 0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
}
.trk-widg:hover { max-width: 340px; background: var(--glass-hover); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }

.tw-img {
  width: 46px; height: 46px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; flex-shrink: 0;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
}
.tw-txt { display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex-shrink: 0; margin-right: 10px; }
.tw-txt small { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; margin-bottom: 2px; }
.tw-txt strong { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: #aaa; text-overflow: ellipsis; overflow: hidden; max-width: 130px; }

.tw-btn {
  background: #fff; color: #000; font-size: 12px; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 100px; border: none;
  cursor: pointer; font-weight: 700; transition: 0.3s;
  opacity: 0; transform: translateX(15px); pointer-events: none; text-transform: uppercase;
}
.trk-widg:hover .tw-btn { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); pointer-events: auto; }
.tw-btn:hover { background: #e0e0e0; transform: scale(1.05); }

.tw-btn.quit { background: rgba(255, 60, 60, 0.15); color: #ff4d4d; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 60, 60, 0.3); }
.tw-btn.quit:hover { background: #ff4d4d; color: #fff; }

/* ModalSSS */
#modal-ui {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; background: var(--bg); z-index: 500; display: none; opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); overflow-y: auto; scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

.m-bg {
  position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 90vh;
  object-fit: cover; opacity: 0.15; filter: blur(40px);
  mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, black 10%, transparent 100%);
  -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, black 10%, transparent 100%);
}

.m-close {
  position: fixed; top: 40px; right: 60px; display:flex; align-items:center; z-index: 10;
}
.m-close-btn {
  width: 45px; height: 45px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--glass); backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center;
  cursor: pointer; transition: 0.3s;
}
.m-close-btn:hover { background: #fff; transform: rotate(90deg) scale(1.05); }
.m-close-btn:hover svg { stroke: #000; }

.m-grid {
  position: relative; z-index: 2; padding: 100px; max-width: 1400px; margin: 0 auto;
  display: flex; gap: 70px; align-items: flex-start;
}

.m-l { width: 340px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.m-l img { width: 100%; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 40px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); border: 1px solid var(--border); margin-bottom: 30px;}

.m-play {
  width: 100%; background: #fff; color: #000; border: none; padding: 20px 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700;
  border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.3s; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 2px;
  display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.m-play:hover { background: #e0e0e0; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(255,255,255,0.15); transform: translateY(-3px); }

.m-actions-row { display:flex; gap:10px; margin-bottom:30px; }
.m-actions-row .show-login-btn { flex:1; margin:0; padding:12px; font-size:12px; text-decoration:none; text-align:center; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }

.m-stats { background: rgba(20,20,20,0.4); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px; padding: 25px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 20px; backdrop-filter: blur(15px);}
.m-rw { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; }
.m-rw small { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1px; }
.m-rw span { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #fff; }

.m-r { flex: 1; padding-top: 10px;}
.m-t { font-size: 72px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -3px; margin: 0 0 10px 0; line-height: 1; text-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);}
.m-d { font-size: 16px; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 3px; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 35px; }

.m-tgs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 35px; }
.m-tg { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 100px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: #ccc; }

.m-desc { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.7; color: #aaa; margin-bottom: 50px; max-width: 850px; font-weight: 300; }

.m-req { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 40px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); padding-top: 40px; }
.m-rc h4 { font-size: 14px; color: #fff; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 2px; margin: 0 0 20px 0; font-weight: 600;}
.m-ri { margin-bottom: 15px; }
.m-ri small { display: block; font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 4px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1px;}
.m-ri span { display: block; font-size: 13px; color: #ccc; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5;}

/*  Alert Popups  */
.popup-wrap {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6); backdrop-filter: blur(15px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(15px);
  display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; z-index: 999999999999;
  opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transition: opacity 0.3s ease, visibility 0.3s ease;
}
.popup-wrap.show { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; }
.popup-box {
  background: rgba(18, 18, 22, 0.85); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  padding: 40px; border-radius: 24px; text-align: center; max-width: 400px; width: 100%;
  box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.8), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  transform: scale(0.95); transition: 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}
.popup-wrap.show .popup-box { transform: scale(1); }
.popup-icon-container {
  width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin: 0 auto 20px auto; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}
.popup-box h2 { margin: 0 0 10px 0; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.5px; color: #fff;}
.popup-box p { color: #aaa; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0 0 25px 0; font-weight: 400; }
.popup-btn-row { display: flex; gap: 12px; justify-content: center; }
.popup-btn { 
  padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; border: none; font-size: 14px; transition: 0.3s; flex: 1;
}
.popup-btn.primary { background: #fff; color: #000; }
.popup-btn.primary:disabled { background: #555; color: #aaa; cursor: not-allowed; }
.popup-btn.secondary { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: #fff; }
.popup-btn:not(:disabled):hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }

/*  Tutorial Page n iFrames, uh this is the ui for the Tutorial page i made  */
.tut-cnt { text-align: center; }
.tut-cnt video { width: 100%; border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--border); box-shadow: 0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); margin-bottom: 30px; background: #000; }

.show-login-btn {
  background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); color: #fff;
  padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 100px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px;
  cursor: pointer; transition: 0.3s; margin-bottom: 40px; display: inline-block;
}
.show-login-btn:hover { background: #fff; color: #000; transform: translateY(-2px); }

#frame-area {
  max-height: 0; overflow: hidden; opacity: 0; transition: max-height 0.8s ease, opacity 0.8s ease;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 30px; margin-top: 10px;
}
#frame-area.show { max-height: 2500px; opacity: 1; }

.f-box { background: #080808; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); text-align: left; }
.f-box h3 { margin: 0 0 15px 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;}
.f-box h3::before { content: ''; width: 4px; height: 14px; background: #fff; border-radius: 4px; }
.f-box iframe { width: 100%; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; }
.f-rac { height: 501px; }
.f-mail { height: 602px; }

.auth-success-box {
  background: rgba(20, 20, 25, 0.8); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 30px; border-radius: 16px; display: inline-block;
  box-shadow: 0 15px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); text-align: center; margin-bottom: 30px;
}
.auth-success-box h3 { margin: 0 0 8px 0; font-size: 20px; color: #fff; font-weight: 600; }
.auth-success-box p { margin: 0 0 20px 0; color: #aaa; font-size: 14px; }

.verify-manual-btn {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.3s;
  margin-top: 15px; width: 100%;
}
.verify-manual-btn:hover { background: #fff; color: #000; }

.settings-box {
  background:var(--glass); border:1px solid var(--border); padding:30px; border-radius:24px;
  backdrop-filter:blur(30px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(30px);
}

.swatch-btn {
  width: 50px; height: 50px; border-radius: 14px; cursor: pointer;
  border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); transition: 0.2s;
}
.swatch-btn:hover { transform: scale(1.1); }
.swatch-btn.active { transform: scale(1.15); border-color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }

.p-card {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  padding: 15px; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; cursor: pointer;
  transition: 0.2s; min-width: 80px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; align-items: center;
}
.p-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); }
.p-card-active { border-color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }
.p-card span { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; }
.p-card svg { stroke: #fff; opacity: 0.8; }

.gp-focus { outline: 3px solid #fff !important; box-shadow: 0 0 20px #fff !important; border-radius: inherit; }

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  #app-wrap { padding: 40px 10px 100px 10px; }
  .hero-cont { height: 220px; border-radius: 16px; }
  .h-title { font-size: 28px; letter-spacing: -1px; }
  .h-stat { font-size: 12px; }
  .h-over { padding: 20px; }
  .sec-head { font-size: 18px; margin-top: 30px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  
  .grid-h { display: flex; flex-wrap: nowrap; overflow-x: auto; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; padding-bottom: 15px; gap: 12px; }
  .grid-h::-webkit-scrollbar { height: 4px; }
  .grid-h::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border-radius: 10px; }
  .grid-h .c-h { width: 260px; flex-shrink: 0; scroll-snap-align: start; border-radius: 12px; }
  
  .grid-v { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(110px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
  .c-v { border-radius: 10px; }
  .c-inf { padding: 15px 10px 10px; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,1), transparent); }
  .c-inf h3 { font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .c-time-hover { font-size: 9px; margin-top: 4px; }
  .c-time-hover svg { width: 10px; height: 10px; }
  .c-inf span { font-size: 9px; }
  
  .m-grid { flex-direction: column; padding: 0; gap: 0; margin-top: 60px; background: var(--bg); border-top-left-radius: 30px; border-top-right-radius: 30px; position: relative; z-index: 3; box-shadow: 0 -10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); }
  .m-bg { height: 280px; opacity: 0.8; filter: blur(2px); mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, black 30%, transparent 100%); -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, black 30%, transparent 100%); }
  .m-l { width: 100%; padding: 20px; box-sizing: border-box; display: flex; flex-direction: column; margin-top: -80px; align-items: center; }
  .m-l img { width: 140px; height: 190px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.9); margin-bottom: 15px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }
  .m-r { padding: 0 20px 30px 20px; box-sizing: border-box; text-align: center; }
  .m-t { font-size: 26px; margin-bottom: 8px; text-align: center; line-height: 1.2; }
  .m-d { font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 20px; text-align: center; color: var(--accent); }
  .m-tgs { justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 20px; }
  .m-actions-row { display: flex; gap: 10px; width: 100%; margin-bottom: 20px; }
  .m-actions-row .show-login-btn { flex: 1; padding: 12px 0; margin: 0; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 10px; }
  .m-play { margin-bottom: 15px; padding: 14px 0; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 14px; width: 100%; }
  .m-stats { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); margin-bottom: 20px; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 15px; }
  .m-desc { font-size: 13px; text-align: left; line-height: 1.6; }
  .m-req { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 20px; text-align: left; }
  .m-close { top: 15px; right: 15px; }
  
  .settings-box { padding: 15px; border-radius: 16px; }
  .p-card { min-width: 60px; padding: 10px; }
  .swatch-btn { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 10px; }
  
  .dock-wrap { width: 95%; bottom: 15px; }
  .main-dock { padding: 6px 8px; width: 100%; justify-content: space-around; }
  .d-logo { margin: 0 4px; width: 20px; height: 20px; }
  .d-btn { padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 11px; }
  .d-sep { height: 16px; margin: 0 2px; }
  .top-notch { padding: 6px 12px; }
  .top-notch span { font-size: 10px; }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .grid-h .c-h { width: 220px; }
  .grid-v { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(100px, 1fr)); }
}

</style>
</head>
<body>

<div style="position: fixed; top: 0; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 1000; display: flex; gap: 10px;">

  </div>

  </div>
</div>

  <div class="fig-line"></div>
</div>

<img src="" id="bg-amb">

<div id="app-wrap">

  <div id="v-cine" class="tab-view active">

          <div class="h-tag" id="hc-tag">RESUME</div>
          
          <h1 class="h-title" id="hc-title">...</h1>
          
          
          <div class="h-stat">

            
            <span id="hc-time"></span>
            <span id="hc-dev"></span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="sec-head">Games We Recommend</div> <! NOTE: FIND A REAL !>
      <div class="marquee-wrap">
        <div class="marquee-track" id="g-recom-track"></div>
      </div>

      <div class="sec-head">Poppy Playtime Universe</div>
      <div class="grid-h" id="g-poppy"></div>

      <div class="sec-head">Racing & Driving</div>
      <div class="grid-h" id="g-race"></div>

      <div class="sec-head">Daily Picks</div>
      <div class="grid-h" id="g-day"></div>

      <div class="sec-head">Trending Now</div>
      <div class="grid-h" id="g-trnd"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
 <! Might add mroe in later updates !>
  <div id="v-lib" class="tab-view">
    <div class="sec-head" style="margin-top:0;">Complete Library</div>
    <div class="lib-search-wrap">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle><line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"></line></svg>
      <input type="text" id="lib-search" placeholder="Search games by name, tag, or genre..." onkeyup="filterLib()">
    </div>
    <div class="grid-v" id="g-lib"></div>
  </div>

  <div id="v-tut" class="tab-view">
    <div class="tut-cnt">
      <h1 style="font-weight: 400; font-size: 42px; margin-bottom: 12px; letter-spacing:-1px;">Setup Guide</h1>
      <p style="color: #888; margin-bottom: 40px; font-size: 15px;">Make sure you watch this quick video so everything runs smoothly.</p>
      
      <video controls><source src="Tutorial.mp4" type="video/mp4"></video> <! IF YOUR MAKING YOUR OWN VERSION, You can change the path and title for the tutorial or remove it i guess !>
      
      <button class="show-login-btn" id="login-trigger" onclick="openAuthTray()">Log in to play</button>

      <div id="auth-success" style="display:none;">
        <div class="auth-success-box">
            <h3>You're All Set!</h3>
            <p>Your Logged In and ready.</p> <! Auto like detect when the user logs in by checking iframe url !>
        </div>
      </div>
      
      <div id="frame-area">
       
        <div class="f-box" id="frame-wrapper">
          
         <h3>Log in with Raccoon</h3>
          <div style="margin-bottom: 15px; padding: 15px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);">
            <p style="margin: 0 0 10px 0; color: #fff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600;">[BETA]: This is temporary, see if you can login by clicking the button below</p>
            <a href="https://www.raccoongame.com/login?redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.raccoongame.com%2Fwap%2Fdist%2F%23%2Fplatform%2Fset&lang=en" target="_blank" style="display: inline-block; padding: 10px 20px; background: #fff; color: #000; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: bold; font-size: 13px;">Open Login in New Tab</a>
          </div>
          <iframe id="rac-frame" class="f-rac" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-forms allow-popups"></iframe>
          <button class="verify-manual-btn" onclick="markAsLoggedIn()">I have successfully logged in</button>
        </div>
        <div class="f-box" id="mail-wrapper">
          <h3>Need a temp email?</h3>
          <iframe class="f-mail" src="https://tempmail.ing/"></iframe> <! this is the link we iframe to the user to give them a temp link !>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="v-set" class="tab-view">

        <div class="swatch-btn btn-sunset" style="background:#f53b57;" onclick="setTheme('sunset')"></div>
        <div class="swatch-btn btn-amethyst" style="background:#a55eea;" onclick="setTheme('amethyst')"></div>
        <div class="swatch-btn btn-gold" style="background:#f1c40f;" onclick="setTheme('gold')"></div>
        <div class="swatch-btn btn-hacker" style="background:#0f0;" onclick="setTheme('hacker')"></div>
        <div class="swatch-btn btn-ocean" style="background:#0abde3;" onclick="setTheme('ocean')"></div>
        <div class="swatch-btn btn-lava" style="background:#ee5253;" onclick="setTheme('lava')"></div>

        <div class="swatch-btn btn-rose" style="background:#f368e0;" onclick="setTheme('rose')"></div>
        <div class="swatch-btn btn-mint" style="background:#1dd1a1;" onclick="setTheme('mint')"></div>

      </div>
      
      <h3 style="margin:40px 0 15px 0; font-size:18px; color:#fff;">Particles</h3>
      <div style="display:flex; gap:15px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
        <div class="p-card card-none" onclick="setParticles('none')">
          <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><line x1="4.93" y1="4.93" x2="19.07" y2="19.07"></line></svg>
          <span>None</span>
        </div>
        <div class="p-card card-snow" onclick="setParticles('snow')">
          <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke-width="2"><line x1="12" y1="2" x2="12" y2="22"></line><line x1="2" y1="12" x2="22" y2="12"></line><line x1="12" y1="12" x2="19" y2="19"></line><line x1="12" y1="12" x2="5" y2="5"></line><line x1="12" y1="12" x2="19" y2="5"></line><line x1="12" y1="12" x2="5" y2="19"></line></svg>
          <span>Snow</span>
        </div>
        <div class="p-card card-rain" onclick="setParticles('rain')">
          <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke-width="2"><line x1="16" y1="13" x2="16" y2="21"></line><line x1="8" y1="13" x2="8" y2="21"></line><line x1="12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="23"></line><path d="M20 16.58A5 5 0 0 0 18 7h-1.26A8 8 0 1 0 4 15.25"></path></svg>
          <span>Rain</span>
        </div>
        <div class="p-card card-stars" onclick="setParticles('stars')">

          <span>Cyber</span>
        </div>
        <div class="p-card card-matrix" onclick="setParticles('matrix')">

          <span>Matrix</span>
        </div>
        <div class="p-card card-bubbles" onclick="setParticles('bubbles')">

          <span>Bubbles</span>
        </div>
        <div class="p-card card-fireflies" onclick="setParticles('fireflies')">

    <div class="m-r">

      <div class="m-tgs" id="mdl-tg"></div>
      <div class="m-desc" id="mdl-dc"></div>
      
      <div class="m-req">

          <div class="m-ri"><small>Processor</small><span id="qm-cpu"></span></div>
          <div class="m-ri"><small>Memory</small><span id="qm-ram"></span></div>
          <div class="m-ri"><small>Graphics</small><span id="qm-gpu"></span></div>
        </div>
        <div class="m-rc">
          <h4>Recommended</h4>
          <div class="m-ri"><small>OS</small><span id="qr-os"></span></div>
          <div class="m-ri"><small>Processor</small><span id="qr-cpu"></span></div>
          <div class="m-ri"><small>Memory</small><span id="qr-ram"></span></div>

        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

If there are any legal disputes or DMCA claims regarding the hosting and playing of these games, they should be directed towards the source host, <strong>Raccoon Games</strong>.</p>

<div class="popup-wrap" id="p-embed-block" onclick="closePopupClick(event)">
  <div class="popup-box" style="max-width: 500px; padding:30px;">
    <div class="popup-icon-container" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);">
      <svg width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2"><polyline points="16 18 22 12 16 6"></polyline><polyline points="8 6 2 12 8 18"></polyline></svg>
    </div>

  <button id="fB" onclick="mnLk()" style="position:absolute; top:60px; right:20px; z-index:9001; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); color:#fff; padding:10px; border-radius:8px; cursor:pointer;" title="Hold ALT + Z for 3 secs to lock mouse">🖵</button>
  <div id="tD" style="position:absolute; top:-100px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); z-index:9004; background:#000; border:2px solid #fff; border-radius:50%; width:50px; height:50px; display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; color:#fff; font-family:sans-serif; font-weight:bold; font-size:20px; transition:top 0.3s ease;">3</div>
  <div id="eD" style="position:absolute; top:-100px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); z-index:9004; background:#ff4d4d; border:2px solid #fff; border-radius:50%; width:50px; height:50px; display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; color:#fff; font-family:sans-serif; font-weight:bold; font-size:20px; transition:top 0.3s ease;">3</div>
  
  <div id="pointer-lock-overlay" style="position:absolute; inset:0; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5); z-index:9000; display:none; justify-content:center; align-items:center; cursor:pointer;">
    <div style="text-align:center; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.85); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); padding:20px; border-radius:12px; max-width:300px;">
      <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0; font-weight:bold; color:#fff;">Pointer Lock Lost</p>

  <iframe id="gF" allow="autoplay;fullscreen;pointer-lock;keyboard-map;clipboard-read;clipboard-write;gamepad" style="width:100%; height:100%; border:none; display:block; outline:none;"></iframe>
</div>

<script src="./random/gamelayout.js"></script>

<script>
//  THE FUNCTIONALITTTYTYYYYYYYYY!!! 
let lsDB=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('cine_store_v10')||'{}');
function sLS(){localStorage.setItem('cine_store_v10',JSON.stringify(lsDB));}
function msToTm(s){if(!s)return"0m";let h=Math.floor(s/3600);let m=Math.floor((s%3600)/60);return h>0?`${h}h ${m}m`:`${m}m`;}
function tsToDt(t){if(!t)return"Never";let d=Date.now()-t;if(d<86400000)return"Today";if(d<172800000)return"Yesterday";return new Date(t).toLocaleDateString(undefined,{month:'short',day:'numeric',year:'numeric'});}
function formatPlaytimeHover(secs){if(!secs)return"00d:00h:00m";let d=Math.floor(secs/86400);let h=Math.floor((secs%86400)/3600);let m=Math.floor((secs%3600)/60);return `${d.toString().padStart(2,'0')}d:${h.toString().padStart(2,'0')}h:${m.toString().padStart(2,'0')}m`;}

function showToast(msg) {
  let t = document.createElement('div');
  t.innerText = msg;
  t.style.cssText = "position:fixed; top:20px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1); backdrop-filter:blur(15px); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); padding:12px 24px; border-radius:100px; color:#fff; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; z-index:9999999999; opacity:0; transition:0.4s;";
  document.body.appendChild(t);
  setTimeout(()=> t.style.opacity='1', 100);
  setTimeout(()=> { t.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(), 400); }, 3000);
}

function clsA2hs() {
  localStorage.setItem('fig_a2hs', '1');
  document.getElementById('m-a2hs').style.bottom = '-200px';
}

window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>{
  let isMobile = /Android|webOS|iPhone|iPad|iPod|BlackBerry|IEMobile|Opera Mini/i.test(navigator.userAgent) || window.innerWidth < 1024;
  let isStandAlone = window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches || window.navigator.standalone || document.referrer.includes('android-app://');
  
  if(isMobile) { 
    setTimeout(() => { showToast("Welcome to Figure - Mobile"); }, 2500); 
    if(!localStorage.getItem('fig_a2hs') && !isStandAlone) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        let el = document.getElementById('m-a2hs');
        if(el) el.style.bottom = '0px';
      }, 5000);
    }
  }

  let b=document.getElementById('new-boot');
  let aw=document.getElementById('app-wrap');
  
  setTimeout(()=>{
    b.style.opacity='0';
    setTimeout(()=>{b.style.display='none';aw.style.opacity='1';}, 800);
  }, 3000);

  let t=localStorage.getItem('figure_theme')||'dark';setTheme(t);
  let p=localStorage.getItem('fig_particles')||'none';setParticles(p);
  
  let uP=new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  let gParam=uP.get('game');let embParam=uP.get('embed');
  
  if(embParam){
    let s=document.createElement('script');
    s.src='./random/gamelayout.js';
    document.head.appendChild(s);
    let chI = setInterval(()=>{
      if(typeof G_DATA!=='undefined') {
        clearInterval(chI);
        let f = G_DATA.find(x=>x.id===gParam);
        if(f) {
           document.body.innerHTML = '<iframe src="'+(f.url||f.path)+'" style="position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:none;z-index:99999999;"></iframe>';
        }
      }
    }, 50);
    return;
  }
  
  if(!localStorage.getItem('cine_legal_accepted'))showPopup('p-legal-block');

  let checkAttempts=0;
  let checkG=setInterval(()=>{
    if(typeof G_DATA!=='undefined'&&Array.isArray(G_DATA)){
      clearInterval(checkG);
      let ef=document.getElementById('error-fallback');if(ef)ef.style.display='none';
      dodeLayout();
      if(gParam){
        let g=G_DATA.find(x=>x.id===gParam);
        if(g){
          cxG = g;
          opMdl(g.id);setTimeout(try2launch,500);
        }
      }
    } else {
      checkAttempts++;
      if(checkAttempts===20){
        let s=document.createElement('script');
        s.src='./random/gamelayout.js';
        document.head.appendChild(s);
      }
      if(checkAttempts>100){
        clearInterval(checkG);
        let ef=document.getElementById('error-fallback');
        if(ef)ef.style.display='block';
      }
    }
  },50);
  rSz();aP();
});

let bgM=new Audio('backgroundmusic.mp3');bgM.loop=true;let bgMuted=localStorage.getItem('bg_muted')==='true';let aInit=false;
function initAudio(){if(!aInit&&!bgMuted){bgM.play().catch(e=>console.log(e));aInit=true;}}
window.addEventListener('pointerdown',initAudio,{once:true});
window.addEventListener('keydown',initAudio,{once:true});

let gpLoop, lastGpState={}, focusedEl=null, lastGpMove=0, curTabIdx=0;
const TABS = ['cine', 'lib', 'tut', 'set'];
function gpInit() {
  if(gpLoop) return;
  gpLoop = requestAnimationFrame(gpUpdate);
}
function gpUpdate() {
  let gps = navigator.getGamepads();
  if(gps[0]) {
    let bA = gps[0].buttons[0].pressed;
    let bB = gps[0].buttons[1].pressed;
    let LB = gps[0].buttons[4].pressed;
    let RB = gps[0].buttons[5].pressed;
    let dU = gps[0].buttons[12].pressed || gps[0].axes[1] < -0.5;
    let dD = gps[0].buttons[13].pressed || gps[0].axes[1] > 0.5;
    let dL = gps[0].buttons[14].pressed || gps[0].axes[0] < -0.5;
    let dR = gps[0].buttons[15].pressed || gps[0].axes[0] > 0.5;

    if(bB && !lastGpState.B) {
      if(document.getElementById('modal-ui').style.display === 'block') clsMdl();
    }
    if(bA && !lastGpState.A && focusedEl) focusedEl.click();
    
    if(LB && !lastGpState.LB) { curTabIdx=(curTabIdx-1+TABS.length)%TABS.length; chgTab(TABS[curTabIdx]); }
    if(RB && !lastGpState.RB) { curTabIdx=(curTabIdx+1)%TABS.length; chgTab(TABS[curTabIdx]); }

    let now = Date.now();
    if((dU || dD || dL || dR)) {
      if(now - lastGpMove > 150) {
        moveFocus(dU, dD, dL, dR);
        lastGpMove = now;
      }
    } else {
      lastGpMove = 0;
    }

    lastGpState = {A: bA, B: bB, LB: LB, RB: RB, U: dU, D: dD, L: dL, R: dR};
    document.getElementById('b-btn-hint').style.display = 'flex';
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(gpUpdate);
}

function moveFocus(u, d, l, r) {
  let els = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.c-h, .c-v, .d-btn, .m-play, .m-close-btn, .show-login-btn, .hero-cont, .swatch-btn, .p-card')).filter(e => e.offsetParent !== null);
  if(els.length === 0) return;
  if(!focusedEl || els.indexOf(focusedEl) === -1) {
    focusedEl = els[0];
    updateFocusUI();
    return;
  }
  let curRect = focusedEl.getBoundingClientRect();
  let best = null;
  let bestDist = Infinity;
  els.forEach(el => {
    if(el === focusedEl) return;
    let rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    let dx = rect.left - curRect.left;
    let dy = rect.top - curRect.top;
    let dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
    let valid = false;
    if(u && dy < -10 && Math.abs(dx) < Math.abs(dy)*2) valid = true;
    if(d && dy > 10 && Math.abs(dx) < Math.abs(dy)*2) valid = true;
    if(l && dx < -10 && Math.abs(dy) < Math.abs(dx)*2) valid = true;
    if(r && dx > 10 && Math.abs(dy) < Math.abs(dx)*2) valid = true;
    if(valid && dist < bestDist) { bestDist = dist; best = el; }
  });
  if(best) {
    focusedEl = best;
    updateFocusUI();
    best.scrollIntoView({behavior: "smooth", block: "center", inline: "center"});
  }
}
function updateFocusUI() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.gp-focus').forEach(e => e.classList.remove('gp-focus'));
  if(focusedEl) focusedEl.classList.add('gp-focus');
}
window.addEventListener("gamepadconnected", (e) => {
  showToast("🎮 Most games should have controller support");
  gpInit();
});

let heroArr=[];let hIdx=0;let heroInterval;
function dodeLayout(){
  try{
    heroArr=[];
    let pg=Object.keys(lsDB).filter(k=>lsDB[k]&&lsDB[k].t>0).sort((a,b)=>((lsDB[b]?lsDB[b].l:0)-(lsDB[a]?lsDB[a].l:0)));
    if(pg.length>0){let lp=G_DATA.find(x=>x.id===pg[0]);if(lp)heroArr.push({...lp,tag:'RESUME',sub:msToTm(lsDB[lp.id].t)+' Played'});}
    let rnd=[...G_DATA].sort(()=>0.5-Math.random()).slice(0,3);
    rnd.forEach(r=>{if(!heroArr.find(x=>x.id===r.id))heroArr.push({...r,tag:'FEATURED',sub:(r.tags||[]).join(" • ")});});
    rendertheBanner();
    if(heroInterval)clearInterval(heroInterval);
    heroInterval=setInterval(()=>{hIdx=(hIdx+1)%heroArr.length;rendertheBanner();},6000);

    let dayHtml='',trndHtml='',libHtml='';
    let popFilter=G_DATA.filter(g=>g.n.toLowerCase().includes('poppy'));
    let raceFilter=G_DATA.filter(g=>(g.tags||[]).includes('Racing')||(g.tags||[]).includes('Driving'));
    let recFilter=[...G_DATA].sort(()=>0.5-Math.random()).slice(0,10);
    
    G_DATA.forEach((g,i)=>{
      libHtml+=makethecard(g,'v');
      if(i<4)dayHtml+=makethecard(g,'h');
      else if(i>=4&&i<8)trndHtml+=makethecard(g,'h');
    });
    
    document.getElementById('g-recom-track').innerHTML=recFilter.map(g=>makethecard(g,'h')).join('').repeat(2);
    document.getElementById('g-poppy').innerHTML=popFilter.map(g=>makethecard(g,'h')).join('');
    document.getElementById('g-race').innerHTML=raceFilter.slice(0,4).map(g=>makethecard(g,'h')).join('');
    document.getElementById('g-day').innerHTML=dayHtml;
    document.getElementById('g-trnd').innerHTML=trndHtml;
    document.getElementById('g-lib').innerHTML=libHtml;
    rfrTrk();
  }catch(e){console.log(e);}
}

function rendertheBanner(){
  if(!heroArr.length)return;let g=heroArr[hIdx];
  document.getElementById('hc-tag').innerText=g.tag;document.getElementById('hc-title').innerText=g.n;
  document.getElementById('hc-time').innerText=g.sub;document.getElementById('hc-dev').innerText=g.dev;
  let imgEl=document.getElementById('hc-img');imgEl.style.opacity=0;
  setTimeout(()=>{imgEl.src=g.bg;imgEl.style.opacity=0.8;},300);
  document.getElementById('hc-box').onclick=()=>opMdl(g.id);
}

function makethecard(g,type){
  let tStr=formatPlaytimeHover(lsDB[g.id]?lsDB[g.id].t:0);
  let th=`<div class="c-time-hover"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 6 12 12 16 14"></polyline></svg>Time Played: ${tStr}</div>`;
  let src=(g.n+' '+(g.tags||[]).join(' ')+' '+g.dev).toLowerCase();
  return `<div class="c-${type}" onclick="opMdl('${g.id}')" data-search="${src}"><img src="${type==='h'?g.bg:g.img}"><div class="c-inf"><h3>${g.n}</h3><span>${g.dev}</span>${th}</div></div>`;
}

function filterLib(){
  let q=document.getElementById('lib-search').value.toLowerCase();
  document.querySelectorAll('#g-lib .c-v').forEach(c=>{c.style.display=c.getAttribute('data-search').includes(q)?'block':'none';});
}

function chgTab(v){
  document.querySelectorAll('.d-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-view').forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('active'));
  let btn=document.getElementById('b-'+v), view=document.getElementById('v-'+v);
  if(btn)btn.classList.add('active');if(view)view.classList.add('active');
  if(v === 'tut') {
    fdM(0, 800);
  } else {
    fdM(0.5, 800);
  }
}

// the auto detecting like when the user logged in
let isAuth=false, devMode=false;
function openAuthTray(){
  document.getElementById('login-trigger').style.display='none';
  let isMobile=/Android|webOS|iPhone|iPad|iPod|BlackBerry|IEMobile|Opera Mini/i.test(navigator.userAgent)||window.innerWidth<1024;
  if(isMobile){
    window.open("https://www.raccoongame.com/login?redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.raccoongame.com%2Fwap%2Fdist%2F%23%2Fplatform%2Fset&lang=en", "_blank");
    let rf=document.getElementById('rac-frame');if(rf)rf.style.display='none';
    let mw=document.getElementById('mail-wrapper');if(mw)mw.style.display='none';
  }else{
    document.getElementById('rac-frame').src="https://www.raccoongame.com/login?redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.raccoongame.com%2Fwap%2Fdist%2F%23%2Fplatform%2Fset&lang=en";
  }
  document.getElementById('frame-area').classList.add('show');
}
function markAsLoggedIn(){if(isAuth)return;isAuth=true;document.getElementById('frame-area').classList.remove('show');setTimeout(()=>{document.getElementById('frame-area').style.display='none';},800);document.getElementById('auth-success').style.display='block';document.getElementById('login-trigger').style.display='none';}
function forceLoginReopen(){
  document.getElementById('auth-success').style.display='none';
  let isMobile=/Android|webOS|iPhone|iPad|iPod|BlackBerry|IEMobile|Opera Mini/i.test(navigator.userAgent)||window.innerWidth<1024;
  if(isMobile) window.open("https://www.raccoongame.com/login?redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.raccoongame.com%2Fwap%2Fdist%2F%23%2Fplatform%2Fset&lang=en", "_blank");
  else document.getElementById('rac-frame').src="https://www.raccoongame.com/login?redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.raccoongame.com%2Fwap%2Fdist%2F%23%2Fplatform%2Fset&lang=en";
  document.getElementById('frame-area').style.display='flex';
  setTimeout(()=>{document.getElementById('frame-area').classList.add('show');},50);
}
let frC=0;document.getElementById('rac-frame').addEventListener('load',()=>{frC++;if(frC>=2&&!devMode)markAsLoggedIn();});
window.addEventListener('keydown',(e)=>{if(e.altKey&&e.key.toLowerCase()==='s'){devMode=true;frC=0;forceLoginReopen();}});

function showPopup(id){let el=document.getElementById(id);el.style.display='flex';setTimeout(()=>el.classList.add('show'),10);}
function hidePopup(id){let el=document.getElementById(id);el.classList.remove('show');setTimeout(()=>el.style.display='none',300);}
function closePopupClick(e){if(e.target.classList.contains('popup-wrap')&&e.target.id!=='p-legal-block')hidePopup(e.target.id);}
function goToTutorial(){hidePopup('p-tut-block');clsMdl();chgTab('tut');}
function checkLegalScroll(el){if(Math.ceil(el.scrollHeight-el.scrollTop)<=el.clientHeight+10)document.getElementById('btn-legal-accept').disabled=false;}
function acceptLegal(){localStorage.setItem('cine_legal_accepted','true');hidePopup('p-legal-block');}

let cxG=null;
function opMdl(id){
  cxG=G_DATA.find(x=>x.id===id);let d=lsDB[id]||{t:0,l:null};
  document.getElementById('mdl-bg').src=cxG.bg;document.getElementById('mdl-post').src=cxG.img;
  document.getElementById('mdl-t').innerText=cxG.n;document.getElementById('mdl-d').innerText=cxG.dev;document.getElementById('mdl-dc').innerText=cxG.desc;
  document.getElementById('mdl-tm').innerText=msToTm(d.t);document.getElementById('mdl-lp').innerText=tsToDt(d.l);document.getElementById('mdl-ac').innerText=cxG.ach;
  document.getElementById('mdl-tg').innerHTML=cxG.tags.map(t=>`<div class="m-tg">${t}</div>`).join('');
  document.getElementById('qm-os').innerText=cxG.rm.os;document.getElementById('qm-cpu').innerText=cxG.rm.cpu;document.getElementById('qm-ram').innerText=cxG.rm.ram;document.getElementById('qm-gpu').innerText=cxG.rm.gpu;
  document.getElementById('qr-os').innerText=cxG.rr.os;document.getElementById('qr-cpu').innerText=cxG.rr.cpu;document.getElementById('qr-ram').innerText=cxG.rr.ram;document.getElementById('qr-gpu').innerText=cxG.rr.gpu;
  let b=document.getElementById('btn-bookmark');if(b)b.href="javascript:(function(){window.location.href='"+window.location.origin+window.location.pathname+"?game="+cxG.id+"';})()";
  let m=document.getElementById('modal-ui');m.style.display='block';setTimeout(()=>m.style.opacity='1',10);
  evalBgMusic();
}
function clsMdl(){let m=document.getElementById('modal-ui');m.style.opacity='0';setTimeout(()=>m.style.display='none',500);evalBgMusic();}

let wAt=false;let dEn=0;let tTr;
function try2launch(){
  let isMobile=/Android|webOS|iPhone|iPad|iPod|BlackBerry|IEMobile|Opera Mini/i.test(navigator.userAgent)||window.innerWidth<1024;
  if(gmWin&&!gmWin.closed&&!isMobile){showPopup('p-sess-block');return;}
  if(isMobile) rnLd();
  else { showPopup('p-tut-block'); wAt=true; }
}

function launchGame(mode) {
  hidePopup('p-launch-mode');
  let tU = cxG.url || cxG.path;
  if (mode === 'tab') {
    let nw = window.open(tU, '_blank');
    gmWin = { closed: false, close: function() { if(nw) nw.close(); clsGm(); } };
    trStart(cxG.id);
  } else {
    rnLd();
  }
}

window.addEventListener('keydown',(e)=>{
  if(e.key==='Enter'&&wAt){
    e.preventDefault();dEn++;clearTimeout(tTr);tTr=setTimeout(()=>dEn=0,500);
    if(dEn===2){
      hidePopup('p-tut-block');wAt=false;dEn=0;
      showPopup('p-launch-mode');
    }
  }
});

let gmWin=null;let gmId=null;let gInt=null;let gSs=0;
function tglV(v){
  if(v==='h'){
    document.getElementById('app-wrap').style.display='block';document.querySelector('.dock-wrap').style.display='flex';
    document.getElementById('game-layer').style.display='none';
    fdM(0.5, 800);
  }else{
    document.getElementById('app-wrap').style.display='none';document.querySelector('.dock-wrap').style.display='none';
    document.getElementById('game-layer').style.display='block';
    fdM(0, 800);
  }
}

function clsGm(e){
  if(e)e.stopPropagation();document.getElementById('n-game').style.display='none';document.getElementById('gF').src="";
  if(gmWin)gmWin.closed=true;if(document.exitFullscreen)document.exitFullscreen().catch(()=>{});
  if(document.exitPointerLock)document.exitPointerLock();if(navigator.keyboard)navigator.keyboard.unlock();
  tglV('h');
}

function mnLk(){
  let f=document.getElementById('gF');let gl=document.getElementById('game-layer');
  if(!document.fullscreenElement){if(gl.requestFullscreen)gl.requestFullscreen().then(()=>{if(navigator.keyboard)navigator.keyboard.lock(['Escape']);}).catch(()=>{});else if(gl.webkitRequestFullscreen)gl.webkitRequestFullscreen();else if(document.documentElement.requestFullscreen)document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();}
  if(f.requestPointerLock)f.requestPointerLock();else if(f.webkitRequestPointerLock)f.webkitRequestPointerLock();else document.body.requestPointerLock();f.focus();
}

let aZc=3,aZi=null,aZd=false;let aCc=3,aCi=null,aCd=false;
window.addEventListener('keydown',(e)=>{
  if(e.altKey&&e.key.toLowerCase()==='z'){if(!aZd&&document.getElementById('game-layer').style.display==='block'){let d=document.getElementById('tD');aZd=true;aZc=3;d.innerText=aZc;d.style.top='20px';aZi=setInterval(()=>{aZc--;if(aZc>0)d.innerText=aZc;else{clearInterval(aZi);d.style.top='-100px';mnLk();}},1000);}}
  if(e.altKey&&e.key.toLowerCase()==='c'){if(!aCd&&document.getElementById('game-layer').style.display==='block'){let d=document.getElementById('eD');aCd=true;aCc=3;d.innerText=aCc;d.style.top='20px';aCi=setInterval(()=>{aCc--;if(aCc>0)d.innerText=aCc;else{clearInterval(aCi);d.style.top='-100px';if(document.exitFullscreen)document.exitFullscreen().catch(()=>{});if(document.exitPointerLock)document.exitPointerLock();if(navigator.keyboard)navigator.keyboard.unlock();}},1000);}}
});
window.addEventListener('keyup',(e)=>{if(e.key.toLowerCase()==='z'||e.key==='Alt'){aZd=false;clearInterval(aZi);let td=document.getElementById('tD');if(td)td.style.top='-100px';}if(e.key.toLowerCase()==='c'||e.key==='Alt'){aCd=false;clearInterval(aCi);let ed=document.getElementById('eD');if(ed)ed.style.top='-100px';}});

let sessionPopUp=false,sTo=null,sTg=false;
setInterval(()=>{if(document.getElementById('game-layer').style.display==='block'){try{let f=document.getElementById('gF');if(f.contentWindow.location.href.includes('https://www.raccoongame.com/login')){if(sessionPopUp&&!sTg){sTg=true;sTo=setTimeout(()=>{document.getElementById('lO').style.display='flex';if(document.exitPointerLock)document.exitPointerLock();},10000);}}else{sTg=false;clearTimeout(sTo);}}catch(e){}}else{sTg=false;clearTimeout(sTo);}},1500);

function rnLd(){
  clsMdl();let tU=cxG.url||cxG.path;
  let isM=/Android|webOS|iPhone|iPad|iPod|BlackBerry|IEMobile|Opera Mini/i.test(navigator.userAgent)||window.innerWidth<1024;
  if(isM){
    showToast("Please note: You will need to click play manually.");
    let nw=window.open(tU,'_blank');
    gmWin={closed:false,close:function(){if(nw)nw.close();clsGm();}};
    trStart(cxG.id);
    return;
  }
  document.getElementById('n-game-title').innerText=cxG.n;document.getElementById('n-game').style.display='flex';
  let f=document.getElementById('gF'),s=document.getElementById('bS'),bt=document.getElementById('bS-t'),lo=document.getElementById('lO');
  if(bt)bt.innerText='Loading '+cxG.n+'...';s.style.display='flex';s.style.opacity='1';lo.style.display='none';tglV('g');
  gmWin={closed:false,close:function(){clsGm();}};setTimeout(()=>{f.src=tU;setTimeout(()=>{if(s){s.style.opacity='0';setTimeout(()=>s.style.display='none',1000);}},1500);},2500);trStart(cxG.id);
}

function trStart(id){
  if(gInt)clearInterval(gInt);gmId=id;if(!lsDB[id])lsDB[id]={t:0,l:Date.now()};lsDB[id].l=Date.now();sLS();gSs=lsDB[id].t;rfrTrk();
  gInt=setInterval(()=>{if(gmWin&&!gmWin.closed){gSs++;if(gSs%5===0){lsDB[id].t=gSs;lsDB[id].l=Date.now();sLS();}}else{clearInterval(gInt);lsDB[id].t=gSs;lsDB[id].l=Date.now();sLS();gmWin=null;gmId=null;gInt=null;rfrTrk();dodeLayout();}},1000);
}

function rfrTrk(){
  let widg=document.getElementById('tk');
  if(gmWin&&gmId){let g=G_DATA.find(x=>x.id===gmId);if(g){document.getElementById('tk-img').src=g.img;document.getElementById('tk-lbl').innerText="Playing Now";document.getElementById('tk-lbl').style.color="#fff";document.getElementById('tk-nm').innerText=g.n;let btn=document.getElementById('tk-btn');btn.className="tw-btn quit";btn.innerText="Quit Game";widg.style.display="flex";}}
  else{let pg=Object.keys(lsDB).filter(k=>lsDB[k].t>0);if(pg.length>0){let bId=pg.sort((a,b)=>lsDB[b].l-lsDB[a].l)[0];let g=G_DATA.find(x=>x.id===bId);if(g){document.getElementById('tk-img').src=g.img;document.getElementById('tk-lbl').innerText="Last Played";document.getElementById('tk-lbl').style.color="#a1a1a6";document.getElementById('tk-nm').innerText=g.n;let btn=document.getElementById('tk-btn');btn.className="tw-btn";btn.innerText="Launch";widg.style.display="flex";}}else widg.style.display="none";}
}

function tkAction(){if(gmWin&&!gmWin.closed)gmWin.close();else{let pg=Object.keys(lsDB).filter(k=>lsDB[k].t>0);if(pg.length>0){let bId=pg.sort((a,b)=>lsDB[b].l-lsDB[a].l)[0];cxG=G_DATA.find(x=>x.id===bId);try2launch();}}}

function fdM(tg,d){
  if(bgMuted)return;
  if(tg>0&&bgM.paused){bgM.volume=0;bgM.play().catch(()=>{});}
  let s=bgM.volume,st=Date.now();if(window.fdIv)clearInterval(window.fdIv);
  window.fdIv=setInterval(()=>{
    let pct=(Date.now()-st)/d;if(pct>=1){clearInterval(window.fdIv);bgM.volume=tg;if(tg===0)bgM.pause();}else bgM.volume=s+(tg-s)*pct;
  },16);
}
function evalBgMusic(){
  if(bgMuted||document.getElementById('game-layer').style.display==='block'){if(window.fdIv)clearInterval(window.fdIv);bgM.pause();return;}
  let vol=0.5;if(document.getElementById('v-tut').classList.contains('active'))vol=0.08;
  fdM(vol,800);
}
function toggleBGM(){
  bgMuted=!bgMuted;localStorage.setItem('bg_muted',bgMuted);
  document.getElementById('music-toggle-btn').innerText=bgMuted?"Unmute Music":"Mute Music";
  if(bgMuted){if(window.fdIv)clearInterval(window.fdIv);bgM.pause();}else{evalBgMusic();}
}

document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
  if(document.hidden) {
    if(!bgMuted && !bgM.paused) fdM(0, 500);
  } else {
    evalBgMusic();
  }
});
window.addEventListener('blur', () => { if(!bgMuted && !bgM.paused) fdM(0, 500); });
window.addEventListener('focus', () => { evalBgMusic(); });

function setTheme(t){
  let r=document.documentElement;
  if(t==='dark'){r.style.setProperty('--bg','#050505');r.style.setProperty('--accent','#ffffff');r.style.setProperty('--border','rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)');}
  else if(t==='figure'){r.style.setProperty('--bg','#0c0202');r.style.setProperty('--accent','#ff3333');r.style.setProperty('--border','rgba(255, 50, 50, 0.15)');}
  else if(t==='neon'){r.style.setProperty('--bg','#020b14');r.style.setProperty('--accent','#00d2ff');r.style.setProperty('--border','rgba(0, 210, 255, 0.15)');}
  else if(t==='forest'){r.style.setProperty('--bg','#010f08');r.style.setProperty('--accent','#05c46b');r.style.setProperty('--border','rgba(5, 196, 107, 0.15)');}
  else if(t==='sunset'){r.style.setProperty('--bg','#120410');r.style.setProperty('--accent','#f53b57');r.style.setProperty('--border','rgba(245, 59, 87, 0.15)');}
  else if(t==='amethyst'){r.style.setProperty('--bg','#0a0310');r.style.setProperty('--accent','#a55eea');r.style.setProperty('--border','rgba(165, 94, 234, 0.15)');}
  else if(t==='gold'){r.style.setProperty('--bg','#0f0e05');r.style.setProperty('--accent','#f1c40f');r.style.setProperty('--border','rgba(241, 196, 15, 0.15)');}
  else if(t==='hacker'){r.style.setProperty('--bg','#020802');r.style.setProperty('--accent','#0f0');r.style.setProperty('--border','rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.15)');}
  else if(t==='ocean'){r.style.setProperty('--bg','#020914');r.style.setProperty('--accent','#0abde3');r.style.setProperty('--border','rgba(10, 189, 227, 0.15)');}
  else if(t==='lava'){r.style.setProperty('--bg','#140402');r.style.setProperty('--accent','#ee5253');r.style.setProperty('--border','rgba(238, 82, 83, 0.15)');}
  else if(t==='cyberp'){r.style.setProperty('--bg','#110214');r.style.setProperty('--accent','#D980FA');r.style.setProperty('--border','rgba(217, 128, 250, 0.15)');}
  else if(t==='ice'){r.style.setProperty('--bg','#050a0f');r.style.setProperty('--accent','#c8d6e5');r.style.setProperty('--border','rgba(200, 214, 229, 0.15)');}
  else if(t==='rose'){r.style.setProperty('--bg','#14020a');r.style.setProperty('--accent','#f368e0');r.style.setProperty('--border','rgba(243, 104, 224, 0.15)');}
  else if(t==='mint'){r.style.setProperty('--bg','#02140d');r.style.setProperty('--accent','#1dd1a1');r.style.setProperty('--border','rgba(29, 209, 161, 0.15)');}
  else if(t==='crimson'){r.style.setProperty('--bg','#140101');r.style.setProperty('--accent','#c23616');r.style.setProperty('--border','rgba(194, 54, 22, 0.15)');}
  localStorage.setItem('figure_theme',t);document.querySelectorAll('.swatch-btn').forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('active'));let act=document.querySelector(`.btn-${t}`);if(act)act.classList.add('active');
}

function getEmbedCode(g){
  let u=g.url||g.path;
  let raw=`(function(){var e=document.createElement('div');e.style='position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;background:#050505;z-index:9999999;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#fff;font-family:sans-serif;font-size:24px;font-weight:bold;';e.innerHTML='<img src="https://freepngimg.com/convert-png/89656-icons-circle-computer-black-white-steam" style="width:80px;margin-bottom:20px;animation:pulse 1.5s infinite;"><div style="letter-spacing:2px;">Powered By Figure Cloud</div><style>@keyframes pulse{0%{transform:scale(1);}50%{transform:scale(1.1);}100%{transform:scale(1);}}</style>';document.body.appendChild(e);setTimeout(function(){e.style.opacity='0';e.style.transition='opacity 0.5s';setTimeout(function(){e.remove();var i=document.createElement('iframe');i.src='${u}';i.style='position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:none;z-index:9999998;';document.body.appendChild(i);},500);},3000);})();`;
  let obf = btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(raw)));
  return '<script>eval(decodeURIComponent(escape(atob("'+obf+'"))));<\/script>';
}

function showEmbedPopup(){if(!cxG)return;document.getElementById('embed-code-area').value=getEmbedCode(cxG);showPopup('p-embed-block');}
function copyEmbedCode(){let a=document.getElementById('embed-code-area');a.select();a.setSelectionRange(0,99999);navigator.clipboard.writeText(a.value);showToast("Embed code copied!");}

document.addEventListener('pointerlockchange',()=>{let o=document.getElementById('pointer-lock-overlay');if(document.getElementById('game-layer').style.display==='block'){if(!document.pointerLockElement)o.style.display='flex';else o.style.display='none';}});
document.getElementById('pointer-lock-overlay').addEventListener('click',()=>{let f=document.getElementById('gF');f.focus();if(f.requestPointerLock)f.requestPointerLock();else if(document.body.requestPointerLock)document.body.requestPointerLock();if(!document.fullscreenElement){let gl=document.getElementById('game-layer');if(gl.requestFullscreen)gl.requestFullscreen();else if(gl.webkitRequestFullscreen)gl.webkitRequestFullscreen();}});

let mX=0,mY=0;
window.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{mX=e.clientX;mY=e.clientY;});

let pC,pCtx,pArr=[],pType='none';
function rSz(){pC=document.getElementById('bg-particles');if(!pC)return;pCtx=pC.getContext('2d');let dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1;pC.width=window.innerWidth*dpr;pC.height=window.innerHeight*dpr;pC.style.width=window.innerWidth+'px';pC.style.height=window.innerHeight+'px';pCtx.scale(dpr,dpr);iP();}
window.addEventListener('resize',rSz);
function iP(){
  pArr=[];if(pType==='none')return;let cnt=(pType==='snow'||pType==='rain'||pType==='matrix')?80:(pType==='fireflies'||pType==='nexus')?60:30;
  for(let i=0;i<cnt;i++){
    pArr.push({
      x:Math.random()*window.innerWidth,y:Math.random()*window.innerHeight,
      r:pType==='snow'?Math.random()*2+1:pType==='stars'?Math.random()*1.5+0.5:pType==='bubbles'?Math.random()*4+2:pType==='fireflies'?Math.random()*2+1.5:2,
      vy:pType==='snow'?Math.random()*1+0.5:pType==='rain'?Math.random()*15+10:pType==='matrix'?Math.random()*5+2:pType==='bubbles'?-(Math.random()*2+1):pType==='fireflies'?(Math.random()*2-1):pType==='nexus'?(Math.random()*1-0.5):0,
      vx:pType==='snow'?Math.random()*0.8-0.4:pType==='cyber'?Math.random()*5+3:pType==='bubbles'?Math.random()*1-0.5:pType==='fireflies'?(Math.random()*2-1):pType==='nexus'?(Math.random()*1-0.5):0,
      l:pType==='rain'?Math.random()*20+10:pType==='cyber'?Math.random()*50+20:0,
      c:pType==='cyber'?'rgba(0,210,255,0.4)':pType==='stars'?'#fff':pType==='matrix'?'#0f0':pType==='bubbles'?'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)':pType==='fireflies'?'rgba(255,255,100,0.8)':pType==='nexus'?'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)':'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)',
      o:Math.random(), do:Math.random()*0.02+0.01,
      char: String.fromCharCode(0x30A0 + Math.random() * 96)
    });
  }
}
function aP(){
  if(!pCtx){requestAnimationFrame(aP);return;}pCtx.clearRect(0,0,window.innerWidth,window.innerHeight);
  if(pType!=='none'){
    pArr.forEach(p=>{
      pCtx.beginPath();
      if(pType==='rain'||pType==='cyber'){pCtx.rect(p.x,p.y,pType==='rain'?1:p.l,pType==='rain'?p.l:1);pCtx.fillStyle=p.c;}
      else if(pType==='matrix'){pCtx.font="14px monospace";pCtx.fillStyle=p.c;pCtx.fillText(p.char,p.x,p.y);if(Math.random()<0.05)p.char=String.fromCharCode(0x30A0+Math.random()*96);}
      else{pCtx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,Math.PI*2);pCtx.fillStyle=p.c; if(pType==='bubbles'){pCtx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';pCtx.stroke();pCtx.fillStyle='transparent';}}
      if(pType==='stars'||pType==='fireflies'){p.o+=p.do;if(p.o>1||p.o<0.1)p.do*=-1;pCtx.globalAlpha=p.o;}
      pCtx.fill();pCtx.globalAlpha=1;
      
      if(pType==='fireflies'){
        let dx=mX-p.x;let dy=mY-p.y;let dist=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
        if(dist<100){p.vx-=dx*0.005;p.vy-=dy*0.005;}
        p.vx*=(Math.random()*0.1+0.9);p.vy*=(Math.random()*0.1+0.9);
      }
      if(pType==='nexus'){
        let dx=mX-p.x;let dy=mY-p.y;let dist=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
        if(dist<150){p.x-=dx*0.02;p.y-=dy*0.02;}
        pArr.forEach(p2=>{
          let d2=Math.sqrt(Math.pow(p2.x-p.x,2)+Math.pow(p2.y-p.y,2));
          if(d2<80){pCtx.beginPath();pCtx.moveTo(p.x,p.y);pCtx.lineTo(p2.x,p2.y);pCtx.strokeStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${1-(d2/80)})`;pCtx.stroke();}
        });
      }
      
      p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;
      if(pType==='snow'||pType==='rain'||pType==='matrix'){if(p.y>window.innerHeight){p.y=-20;p.x=Math.random()*window.innerWidth;}}
      else if(pType==='cyber'){if(p.x>window.innerWidth){p.x=-100;p.y=Math.random()*window.innerHeight;}}
      else if(pType==='bubbles'){if(p.y<0){p.y=window.innerHeight+20;p.x=Math.random()*window.innerWidth;}}
      else if(pType==='fireflies'||pType==='nexus'){
        if(p.x<0||p.x>window.innerWidth)p.vx*=-1;
        if(p.y<0||p.y>window.innerHeight)p.vy*=-1;
      }
    });
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(aP);
}
function setParticles(t){pType=t;localStorage.setItem('fig_particles',t);iP();document.querySelectorAll('.p-card').forEach(c=>c.classList.remove('p-card-active'));let act=document.querySelector(`.card-${t}`);if(act)act.classList.add('p-card-active');}

</script>
</body>
</html>
